notes: Draft short Eastern course, independently digitized from March 2025 Environment Canterbury aerial imagery via LINZ (CC BY 4.0). Corrects an OSM Northern junction spur that doubled back 44 m along the straight. Selected image road-edge pins use centripetal curve interpolation; their paired midpoints reconstruct the centerline. Sampled vertices are reconstruction controls, not independent measurements. Historical identity and direction remain provisional. Timing is missing. No nominal width or catalogue length is fitted. Original source recipe and correction evidence retained in sources/research/ruapuna-eastern-route-correction.json.

The centerline is refined to the midpoint of the observed road edges, including both starting-grid rows up to the pit-wall edge. Shared-pavement joins remain estimated. Earlier image centerline and rejected grid-edge proposal are retained in the correction evidence.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 68 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Road edges selected from the pinned March 2025 Environment Canterbury imagery via LINZ. Visible edge pins use smooth centripetal interpolation; collinear reconstruction knots retain the observed straights. Dense cross-section intersections sample these fitted curves and are not additional independent image observations. Northern straight/return, Southern Dipper and Eastern pit-exit/service shared-pavement openings use virtual joins between visible adjacent edge positions; those joins are estimated, not physical measured limits. No nominal width or catalogue length is fitted. Borders remain unverified, curbs illustrative, terrain elevation estimated and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
